title: On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft
author: Stephen King
summary: Stephen King tells the story of how he became a writer, then sets out his views on the craft, from vocabulary and adverbs to plotting and revision. A final section covers the accident that nearly killed him in 1999.
readIf: you write, or want an unpretentious look at how a prolific novelist works.
skipIf: you want a formal writing course or you dislike King's blunt opinions.
